messages:
maria: Hey team — finalizing the SI integrator artifact handoff for the marketplace listing. Need a concrete list of what security/compliance docs we expect from the SI and how they should deliver them (presigned, upload, NDA?). Deadline: COB next Wed. Who owns redaction + presign TTL?
aj: @maria quick note: we require SOC2 Type 2 (last 12 months) and a 3rd-party pen test summary. Full pen report can be shared on NDA only. Also need network diagrams + data flow (PII in scope?). :eyes:
devon: PII: partner says no customer PII included, only environment screenshots. For delivery: our integrator prefers to upload to their S3 and share presigned URLs. Is that ok?
maria: That's fine as long as presigned URLs meet our TTL + KMS rules and we get an index manifest. We want presign TTL <= 72h and an owner email in the filename/manifest. Also need a redaction statement from vendor (what they removed).
aj: Encryption: presigned objects must be encrypted with a CMK or use SSE-S3 and we must get the key alias if CMK. HSM attestation (if used) should be included as a separate artifact.
sam: For clarity, our recommended flow: integrator uploads to their bucket, generates presign, pushes a small manifest JSON to our intake endpoint. We can also generate presigns if they want us to host artifacts. Example presign command they can use:
```
aws s3 presign s3://integrator-bucket/si-artifacts/si-package-1749999999.zip --expires-in 259200
```
(259200 secs = 72h) :thumbsup:
devon: If we host, who pays egress? Partner prefers to host to avoid costs. They asked if a short presign TTL + staged redaction would be acceptable (upload unredacted, then provide redacted version).
aj: No unredacted uploads to our bucket. If they must upload unredacted to their own bucket, we require an encrypted presign and an explicit retention/erase plan in the manifest. Redacted copy is what we publish to marketplace.
maria: OK — timeline: devon please get integrator to produce: SOC2 Type 2 cert (pdf), pen test summary + attestation that full report available under NDA, network diagram, manifest (JSON) with owner/contact, redaction statement, HSM attestation if applicable. Due COB next Wed. Who is owner?
devon: I'll own collection + initial verification. Will assign a partner contact and push checklist.
artifact-bot: created presign-request-1749999999, status: awaiting-manifest (auto-note)
aj: Also flag: include contact for legal/NDAs, and include a checksum (sha256) for each artifact in manifest. We will verify checksums before accepting.
sam: small tweak — manifest fields we expect: {"filename","sha256","size","uploader","kms_key_alias","presign_expiry","redaction_status","owner_email"} — send as JSON (one-line).
maria: Sounds good. devon, can you confirm partner accepts sha256 in manifest and CMK alias? If yes, we'll send the official partner checklist tonight. :wave:
devon: Confirmed, partner agrees to sha256 + will provide CMK alias if using customer-managed keys. I'll post the checklist and owner assignment by EOD today.
aj: Great. I'll prepare the minimal legal language for the NDA pointer we can include with the checklist.
maria: Thanks all — once artifacts start rolling in, tag me and @aj. We'll do a quick compliance triage. :thumbsup:
